decisions.reason: The quoted sentence explicitly states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCL) are 'defined by shared clinical and pathological features, including seizures'. The disease is the grammatical subject, and seizures are listed as a defining feature. This directly supports the relationship NCL has_phenotype seizures.

The quoted sentence explicitly states that NCL includes 'progressive decline in vision' as one of the 'shared clinical and pathological features'. This directly establishes that NCL has the phenotype of visual decline.

The quoted sentence explicitly lists 'progressive decline in...neurocognition' as a defining feature of NCL. 'Neurocognition' or decline therein is reasonably resolved as cognitive impairment, a phenotype of the disease.

The quoted sentence explicitly lists 'progressive decline in...motor functioning' as one of the 'shared clinical and pathological features' of NCL. This directly supports motor decline as a phenotype of the disease.

The quoted sentence explicitly states that NCL is characterized by 'accumulation of autofluorescent lysosomal storage material'. This accumulation is presented as a defining pathological feature of the disease, which constitutes a mechanism by which the disease manifests at the cellular level.
